title: Concept: SQLite driver error text disclosed in a response
description: SQLite reports the database path in most of its operational errors. On a single-host deployment that path locates the data directory, and the presence of the driver tells the caller the application is a small-footprint deployment with no separate database to reach.
applicability: Responses generated by a PHP, Python, Java or Node service backed by SQLite.
risk: The caller learns the absolute path of the database file and the deployment shape, which is the reconnaissance step before a path-traversal or backup-file attempt.
